decisions.statement: The email and task and temper-task and text inboxes are each polled on their own.
The write puts the count now and whether that inbox was cleared to zero today.
The counts land on the ESO day's daily-tracking row.
The email count also lands on the opened day's email entry.
The email count is kept on the opened day only where the new count is lower than the old count.
A source that fails is left out of the write rather than written as nothing.
A source that fails is named among the sources the run reports as failed.
A run in which a source failed still ends well.
A persist write that fails ends the run as an operational error.
A tick is one poll followed by one write.
The run is over once that tick is done.

definition: one poll of every inbox, written onto the day's tracking row
